europe_now.title: Deadly Paris Shooting Investigated as Terrorism
europe_now.summary: French authorities are investigating a deadly shooting near Paris as a racist terrorist attack after one person was killed and several others were wounded. President Emmanuel Macron visited the scene following the arrest of a suspect.

europe_now.title: Large-Scale Prisoner Swap Between Ukraine and Russia
europe_now.summary: Ukraine and Russia have completed a substantial prisoner exchange involving hundreds of captured personnel from both sides. The diplomatic development comes amid ongoing regional tensions and persistent aerial attacks.

top_stories.title: Domestic Security and Protests in France
top_stories.summary: French authorities have tightened security restrictions and banned specific protests amid ongoing civil unrest and student demonstrations. President Emmanuel Macron recently convened with student union representatives to address accumulated frustrations.

top_stories.title: Anti-Corruption Investigation in Hungary
top_stories.summary: Hungarian authorities have placed a former central bank chief in custody as part of an ongoing corruption investigation. The high-profile detention marks a notable development under the current government administration.
